description.zh: 泳道组涉及所有应用ID列表，多个应用之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: IDs of all applications that are related to the lane group. Separate multiple applications with commas (,).
The ingress application. The application is in the EDAS:{application ID} format.

description.zh: 自定义命名空间的RegionId。格式为：`物理Region:自定义命名空间标识符`，例如`cn-hangzhou:test`。
description.en: The ID of the custom namespace. The ID is in the physical region ID:custom namespace identifier format. Example: cn-hangzhou:test.
The name of the lane group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas insert-swimming-lane-group --name test --entry-app EDAS:5cc89013-9232-4b36-b3eb-ff89b3d20000 --app-ids bdb251cc-02a6-48dd-891b-2ab21b250000,ee33ed0c-fddc-47b5-9f63-e1ccc4be0000 --logical-region-id cn-hangzhou:test --region cn-hangzhou
